headline: Sensex and Nifty face volatile opening amid global slips and corporate developments in IIFL and Swan Energy

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: US markets like the Dow and S&P 500 slipped as oil prices stayed near $100
IT stocks dragged the market in the previous session, pushing Nifty below 23,350
The NSE IPO received a strong response with 6x subscription on its final day
Asian markets including Nikkei and Kospi are providing mixed signals for the Indian opening
whatHappening: CCI cleared Fairfax India's proposal to acquire an additional stake in IIFL Capital Services
Swan Defence is planning to hire 550 additional employees by March 2027
Internal tensions at Tata Sons were reported regarding casting vote rights between board and trusts
Samsung India reported a 36% decline in FY26 profit due to falling export revenue
summary: Indian markets are set for a volatile session influenced by slipping US indices and high crude oil prices. Corporate highlights include CCI's approval for the IIFL-Fairfax deal and Swan Defence's recruitment drive. The successful NSE IPO subscription and IT sector performance remain key points of interest for investors.
